decisions.reason: Android API level 35 and Android dependency updates do not alter the independently defined iOS modernization state; its same-message iOS updates arise directly from the broader accepted proposal.
The Android modernization change does not alter iOS certificate renewal or signing readiness.
Targeting Android API level 35 and updating dependencies does not itself change the separate requirement to remove the unused READ_PHONE_STATE permission.
The Android modernization change has no necessary effect on the iOS Privacy Manifest requirement.
Android API and dependency modernization does not necessarily modify the independent lightweight-app optimization goal.
The Android API level and dependency changes do not alter the confirmed full-application localization coverage.
Android modernization does not change the independently required RTL layout behavior.
The source decision does not resolve whether the Youku video should remain or be removed; that lifecycle decision is made only in the later message 40, which cannot be propagated from message 38.
Android API modernization has no necessary effect on the independent iOS size-optimization goal.
The Android API level and dependency updates do not alter iOS full-application localization coverage.
Targeting Android API level 35 and updating dependencies does not necessarily change the independently accepted Android App Bundle packaging format.
The Android modernization change does not affect the independent iOS Thinning distribution optimization method.
